_about: The second run of Qwen 3 1.7B, after results/initial-qwen3-1.7b was read.

Still exploratory, and still never confirmatory evidence. It exists to show that the four things the first run exposed are fixed: position was decided by a source's name, the refusal family could only express one of its two options, a trial that called a tool was cut off before it could answer, and 154 format trials could not be told apart from a model that cannot produce the artifact at all.

design pairwise-balanced: the same conflicts as the first run, in the same scenarios, with the same source pairs, option pairs and flips -- laid out in a balanced arrangement instead of always in source-name order, and with the task placed rather than always last.

composition_sizes [1, 2]: every conflict is also sent as two solo trials, one per side. A solo trial is the conflict with the other source's turn deleted and nothing else changed, so an option the model cannot produce unopposed is visible as that rather than as a precedence result. This triples the trial count and is the reason the run exists.

repeats 3: one draw per item at temperature 0.7 cannot be told apart from the item itself. Three can. The draws are breadth-first -- every trial once, then every trial again -- so a run stopped by the clock is a complete single-draw dataset and not a third of one.

tool_turns 6: the loop answers a tool call with a neutral stub result and asks again, up to six times. The first run sent one request and stopped, so an ordering trial that emitted its first step scored UNRESOLVED and a format trial that read the config wrote nothing.
composition_max_sources stays 2. The composition sets that carry the main claim stay closed on this model.
Run it with scripts/run_trials.sh balanced-qwen3-1.7b. The same command resumes.
